name: 28-refuse-a-signature-from-an-open-filed-task
why: P is filed and open and gives q, which has a signature; no interface holds q, since nothing needed it when P was filed. N may not wait on P for it: P cannot be changed to implement an interface, and the wait would break O3. The way on: drop and re-add P if no phase has started, or re-plan once P is done (D29).
